rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow Roberts opinion holding that, absent congressionally prescribed standards and procedures under Section 5, a State may not exclude a presidential candidate from the ballot based on Section 3. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito (history/original-meaning and stronger non-self-execution language) and Sotomayor (dissent emphasizing state ballot-administration authority and judicial enforceability with due process).
